title: Harden the ported specs: no vacuous scenarios (audit fixes)
description:
## Goal

An audit of every feature on features/ported-features.txt (report: the step-audit.md written by the audit agent, summarized here) found scenarios that pass without proving anything. Each ported feature replaces a Python spec, so a vacuous scenario is a hole in the safety net. This ticket is a HARD GATE: TS-39 (rehearsal) and TS-40 (the flip) must not start until it is closed.

## Findings and fixes (all file:line are on origin/develop at 08752892)

1. **org_path_routing is vacuous.** The routes in conversation/src/http/app.ts:100-128 return canned channel, 403 and empty-message responses, and the Then steps for the principal marker and waitlist-safe assert against constants defined in the step file (features-support/steps/org-path-routing.steps.ts:6-7). Fix: real handlers over the MessagingStore, Givens that create bots and channels through them, and assert marker steps against the registered routes. (PR for TS-14, #416, rewrites part of this; re-audit after it merges.)
2. **v1_security_policy_exclusions is vacuous.** The When step records the exclusion itself and the Then asserts it was recorded (features-support/steps/policy.steps.ts:365-377); the "no worker claims enforced" set is never written (src/policy/capability-policy.ts:589); sink denial and prompt wording flags are set unconditionally (capability-policy.ts:596-600). Fix: remove self-recording, derive the flags from real evaluation.
3. **Policy features have unfalsifiable Thens.** `unblocked_egress` is never populated and `modelVisibleSecrets` returns an empty array (browser_context_policy, page_content_authority, prompt_injection_containment). Make them real so those Thens can fail. Delete the by-hand fallback at policy.steps.ts:265-277 and the dead gated-read steps at 531-580.
4. **organizations has empty steps:** `the store is recycled` (org.steps.ts:342) must use a second store handle, `no computer exists` (465-467) must use a computer lookup, `an identity exists` must read the store rather than re-sign-in.
5. **There is no production MessagingStore.** Only the interface exists; the in-memory double in features-support is the only implementation. Write a real DynamoDB-backed MessagingStore (the item layouts and codecs are in src/store/), move the creation rate-limit decision from the in-memory test double (in-memory-messaging-store.ts:70-85) into domain code, and run me, create_organization, organization_creation_caps, invite_organization and organizations against it on moto.
6. **The members CLI steps call the kernel directly** (create_organization, organization_creation_caps, invite_organization, me). Port the members CLI (this overlaps TS-12) and make the steps run it and check stdout and exit code.
7. **cognito_principal:** the last scenario calls `resolvePrincipal` directly on a route that does not exist and uses a fake directory. Make it a real HTTP request with StorePrincipalDirectory. Remove the duplicate manifest line (features/ported-features.txt lists cognito_principal twice).
8. **Weak asserts:** pi_session_ownership (two), channel_mailbox_and_log (two plus a bot-list shortcut), invite_organization (one web SPA scenario asserts state the Given seeded). Strengthen each.
9. src/policy/sinks.ts and ceiling.ts are exercised by no manifest feature. Either cover them with the features that need them (member_ceiling_sinks and capability_sink_wiring, when the tool loop and channels land) or list them as covered-later in this ticket.

## Definition of done

For every feature on the manifest: a mutation check per scenario group (break the production behavior, the scenario fails) is recorded in the closing comment, no step assigns an outcome, no placeholder or no-op steps remain, and a re-audit by a fresh agent rates every feature "real".

Feature: Ported specs prove behavior
  Scenario: A ported scenario fails when production behavior breaks
    Given any scenario of a ported feature
    When the production behavior it covers is broken
    Then the scenario fails

comments.author: home
comments.text: Progress: #418 (TS-12) fixed audit items 4 (organizations empty steps) and 6 (members CLI steps run the real CLI); #417 (TS-41) delivered item 5 (production Dynamo store, rate limit in domain code); #416 rewrote the org_path_routing steps onto real routes. Remaining: items 1 (stub routes) 2, 3, 7, 8, 9.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Add to the gate (from TS-17, PR for chatticus-27c8bf): (10) scenarios that pass under cucumber-js but sit in features that cannot be fully ported are NOT protected by CI, because the manifest is per feature. Split each such feature into a ported feature file (the passing scenarios, text unchanged) and the remainder, as TS-16 did with message_admission.feature. Affected so far: bot_turns scenarios 2-7 and six turn scenarios of messages.feature. (11) turn_attempts now asserts a single turn.completed event, weaker than the Python scenario because no executor commits a message yet: strengthen it when TS-18 lands. (12) Obsolete by design: 'user active turns can be listed' (users/{u}/turns is not in the design). Record each removed or obsolete Python scenario in the cutover ticket TS-40 so nothing disappears silently.

comments.author: home
comments.text: (13) From the TS-21 investigation: add scenarios for (a) a recovered attempt not double-counting spend (re-run of a turn after a lease takeover must not add the same usage twice: the delta over ledger_input_recorded and ledger_output_recorded under the attempt fence is the mechanism, and nothing tests it), and (b) the terminal-failure spend recording path (executor.ts ~line 258). Both with mutation checks. Add to vendor_ledger.feature as new scenarios or a new feature file.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Part A merged (PR 440): audit items 2, 3, 9. Policy Thens now fail under real mutations (list in the PR). New ported feature capability_policy_isolated_checks (7 scenarios). Covered later: denyIfExceedsMemberStanding via member_ceiling_sinks.feature. Part B (items 1, 7, 8, 10, 11, 13) still open, then a fresh-agent re-audit closes the gate.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Gate closed: parts A and B (PR 440, 441), round 2A (444), 2B (447), disk guard (449), TS-45 terminal regate (443), TS-46 web features (446), TS-47 remaining ports (445), TS-49 real web harness (448). Re-audit report: 69 REAL / 26 WEAK before round 2; round 2 fixed all mutation-confirmed and static weak findings. Remaining recorded limitations: accessibility scenario uses shared constants; a few Thens cannot fail independently (listed in PR 447); paid-but-not-provisioned has no payment model; obsolete scenarios: messages.feature user-active-turns and 6 undefined turn scenarios, demo_cli list-in-flight, @wip delegated_authority and escalation_approval, private-repo intake features.

right_now_summary: The ported specs were hardened, and the final audit recorded remaining limits and obsolete scenarios.
